scope: Durable export directory publication, ownership-limited rollback, metadata-first bounded verification and controlled failures for corrupt archives and nonregular sources.

observed: Export returned success without directory entry synchronization.
Marker retirement error removed complete exported data.
Recursive rollback removed a file added by another writer.
Unknown ZIP members were opened before validating the member list.
ZIP symlink metadata was accepted when file contents matched the manifest.
Invalid Deflate data escaped as an unhandled zlib exception.

focused.command: PYTHONPATH=tests .venv/bin/python -W error::ResourceWarning -m unittest tests.test_export_publication tests.test_exports tests.test_backups tests.test_backup_durability tests.test_inspection

checks: 本轮运行记录可下载经过校验的完整 ZIP，包含结果、事件、报告、证据与上下文清单
完整对话导出包含实际状态和快照时间，下载后继续保留输入草稿
停止任务的记录包保留真实终态且不混入旧报告，对话明确标注未完成

invariants: Persist newly created parent names, incomplete markers and complete payload names before retiring the marker.
Do not delete complete exports after entering marker retirement.
Record ownership before writing each file; do not recursively delete directories or remove replaced files.
Reject unlisted members, nonregular types and declared size violations before opening payloads.
Validate manifest declarations before reading result, event, evidence or context bodies.
Bound file reads and reject size changes observed during verification.
Reject top-level named pipes without waiting for a writer.
Translate malformed Deflate streams into a controlled CLI error.
Preserve historical format-1 verification, empty event files, stored ZIPs and saved report rendering.

earlier_attempts.reason: Three HTTP tests could not bind localhost inside the restricted sandbox; the approved reruns passed.

earlier_attempts.followup: Added descriptor validation for the top-level ZIP source and a timed CLI regression for FIFO inputs; final 992-test run passed.

limits: Checks protect format and snapshot consistency; they do not certify the real-world task outcome.
Permitted ZIP compression is stored or Deflate, matching application-generated format-1 exports.
Payload limit remains 256 MiB in aggregate; manifest limit is 64 KiB.
Failure injection and process termination do not emulate real power failure, defective devices or network filesystems.
Directory synchronization must be supported; no silent durability downgrade.
Candidate uses an isolated target installation with existing Python dependencies, not a fresh dependency environment.
No live user data, external models, version bump, published artifact replacement or git commit.
